remarks: Experience modern comfort and timeless character in this beautifully updated 2 bedroom, 1.5-bath residence at 925 Delaware Ave, Unit 1D, located within Buffalo’s iconic Campanile. This spacious, light filled unit seamlessly blends contemporary updates with the architectural charm of its storied address. Step into the welcoming common area foyer with 24/7 doorman and down the hallway that leads to the residence door opening to a generous living and dining area featuring classic parquet flooring and abundant natural light as well as a convenient half bath adds functionality for guests.. The well appointed kitchen offers an electric range, refrigerator, dishwasher, tile flooring, a convenient peninsula with additional seating & private doorway leading to stunning professionally maintained garden perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The spacious primary bedroom features two closets and an adjoining Jack and Jill full bath with tub/shower combination adjoining the 2nd bedroom.  Residents enjoy the distinctive architectural character of this landmark building along with exceptional amenities including laundry facilities, dedicated basement storage and 24-hour concierge/doorman service. Pet-friendly building. Garage parking available for rent. Ideally located just moments from Buffalo’s vibrant dining, arts, entertainment, and cultural attractions, this rare residence offers an elegant opportunity to enjoy sophisticated city living in one of Buffalo’s most iconic buildings. Rented garage parking spot is $305/month on a month to month bases.
